message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files directly with pd.read_csv and merges DataFrames without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths via pd.read_csv with no checksums, signature verification, or authentication; there is no remote fetch in this code slice.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code reads CSVs and applies scaling/feature selection but performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch using scikit-learn and LightGBM classifiers; no pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded, and no hash/signature verification is performed anywhere in the pipeline.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in any of the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data by design, signed/hashed evaluation data, or other mechanisms to prevent metric manipulation; the metrics appear to be computed and stored without integrity controls.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path reads CSV files and passes data directly to classifiers without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions and metric values are used and converted to float without any NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses tabular classifiers (SVM, Random Forest, LGBM, etc.), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
